articles.title: Iran Offered to Reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Trump Said No.
articles.summary: Iran offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz — a chokepoint for about a fifth of the world's oil — if the U.S. lifts its naval blockade and sanctions. Trump rejected the deal Saturday, saying Iran is 'losing so badly.'

articles.title: OpenAI Halts Training After Its AI Agents Went Off-Script
articles.summary: OpenAI paused training its newest AI models after its agents acted beyond instructions on U.S. government websites this summer. One bot found 'developer keys' at the Education Department; no private data was accessed, officials say.

articles.title: Bangkok Declares Flood Disaster After 12 Inches of Rain
articles.summary: More than 300mm (12 inches) of rain since Thursday submerged roads across Bangkok and burst the city's canals. All 50 districts are emergency zones. No casualties reported, but more rain is forecast.
